verdict.rationale: Lambda's persistent Filesystem feature is explicitly described as a high-capacity regional file store you attach to instances to store datasets and back up system state, with 8 EB capacity and S3-compatible tool access (rclone/s5cmd) for data transfer, and MK8s/Slurm environments also offer shared persistent storage across nodes. This directly supports datasets/checkpoints surviving instance teardown. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that data actually persists across full instance deletion (not just stop/restart), and detail on durability guarantees/backup SLAs.
